settings.negativeHint: Lets a sale go through even when the system shows no stock.

guide.loginLink: New to TrilloPOS? Read the shop guide
guide.title: Run your shop in TrilloPOS
guide.lede: Your products, stock, orders and money in one place. Every day it tells you what you sold and what you made. It works in your phone's browser and on a laptop.
guide.languageNote: The language menu at the top switches this guide, and TrilloPOS itself, between English and Burmese.
guide.sampleNote: The pictures come from a sample shop, Shwe Online Shop. Your screens show your own shop. Tap any picture to see it bigger.

menu.title: Finding your way
menu.intro: On a laptop the menu is on the left. On a phone it is the bar along the bottom:
menu.home: Home: how your shop is doing today.
menu.sell: Sell, the round + in the middle: a new order.
menu.more: More: everything else. Customers, Money, Settings and your account.
menu.paths: In this guide, Money → Owed to you means: open Money, then tap Owed to you.
menu.shot: More opens the full menu. Money holds Owed to you, You owe and Expenses.

start.title: Getting started
start.createBody: On the sign-in page, tap Create a business. Enter your name, your shop's name, your phone (like 09 7xx xxx xxx), a password of at least 8 characters, and the sign-up code you were given. Then tap Start selling.
start.signInShot: Tap Create a business. The language menu is at the top.
start.createShot: Fill in the form, then tap Start selling.
start.setupIntro: Open Settings → Business details (on a phone, under More) and set:
start.setupTax: Tax %: 0, unless you really charge commercial tax. With the starting value of 5, your profit would look smaller than it is.
start.setupCredit: New customers' credit limit: the value of your biggest usual parcel, for example 300,000. Cash on delivery needs this.
start.setupDays: Days to pay: how long your delivery company takes to pay you, for example 14.
start.productsIntro: Open Products and tap Add product for each item. Enter the Product name and Retail price, then:
start.productsCost: Opening unit cost: what one cost you. This is how TrilloPOS works out your profit, so it is worth entering.
start.productsQty: Opening quantity: how many you have now.
start.productsReorder: Reorder point: when stock falls to this number, the dashboard tells you to buy more.
start.sellOnlineBody: New products start with it unticked, and an online order only lists products that have it ticked.
start.priceShot: Cost and price. TrilloPOS shows the profit on each one.
start.stockShot: How many you have, and Sell online ticked.

orders.title: Every order
orders.intro: For every Facebook, Viber or phone order.
orders.addTitle: Tap Sell and add the products
orders.addBody: Tap Sell (on a laptop, New sale). Because your business is an online shop, it opens in Online order mode, so there is no drawer or shift to open.
orders.addTap: Tap a product to add it. Tap it again to add one more.
orders.addShot: The bar at the bottom takes you to the cart.
orders.payTitle: Choose the buyer and how they paid
orders.payBody: Tap Cart and payment. Under Customer, search by name or phone and tap Select, or add a new customer. Change quantities in the cart if you need to. Then choose the Method:
orders.walletHow: KBZPay, WavePay, AYA Pay, bank transfer
orders.walletWhat: Choose that method and type the transaction number under Reference.
orders.codWhat: Choose On credit (pay later). Nothing else to type: the order waits under Owed to you until the courier pays you.
orders.customerShot: The buyer, with what they owe and the credit they have left.
orders.paymentShot: Cash on delivery: On credit (pay later).
orders.chargeBody: The receipt appears. You can screenshot it for the customer.
orders.chargeStock: Stock goes down by itself. You never count stock by hand in the app.
orders.receiptShot: The receipt of a cash-on-delivery order.

courier.title: When the delivery company pays you
courier.body: Open Money → Owed to you. Every cash-on-delivery parcel not yet paid is listed with the buyer's name.
courier.steps: For each parcel in the courier's payment, tap it, then tap Whole amount. Choose the method (for example Bank transfer), type the courier's reference, and press Record repayment.
courier.feesBody: The courier usually keeps a fee from the total. Record each parcel's full price here, then record the fees once under Money → Expenses, in a category such as Delivery fees. That way your profit shows what really happened.
courier.repayShot: Whole amount fills in what is left to pay.

returns.title: When a parcel comes back
returns.body: Or when a customer returns something. Open Sales, find the order and open it. Under Return, enter how many came back.
returns.restock: Leave Restock ticked if the item can be sold again. Untick it if it is damaged. Then choose the Refund method:
returns.cod: A cash-on-delivery parcel that was never paid: On credit (pay later). It cancels what the buyer owes.
returns.paid: A customer you paid back: the method you used, such as KBZPay or cash.
returns.shot: One longyi came back: back on the shelf, and the buyer owes less.

stock.title: New stock from your supplier
stock.body: Open Products → Stock and tap New stock entry. Choose Stock in, the supplier and the product, then enter the quantity and what one cost you. Press Post.
stock.owe: What you owe the supplier then shows under Money → You owe. When you pay them, record the payment there.
stock.shot: 40 packs in from the supplier, at 2,100 each.

expenses.title: Other money going out
expenses.body: Open Money → Expenses for delivery fees, packaging, phone top-ups or boosting posts. Tap Record expense, pick a category and enter the amount.
expenses.categories: The first time, add your categories under Categories, for example Delivery fees, Packaging and Boosting posts.
expenses.shot: This month's expenses, with the total.

day.title: What your day looks like
day.sales: Sales today / this month: what customers paid.
day.profit: Gross profit: sales less what the goods cost you. The line after expenses also takes off your expenses.
day.owed: Customers owe you: credit and cash-on-delivery parcels not yet paid. Tap it to see who.
day.owe: You owe suppliers: stock you received and have not paid for yet.
day.low: Running low, further down: products at or below their reorder point.
day.shot: A day of six online orders.

password.title: Your password
password.change: Change it any time. Open the menu under your name (on a phone, More, then your name at the bottom) and choose Account.
password.forgot: Forgot it? Ask the person who gave you the sign-up code. They can give you a temporary password in a minute; then change it under Account. After too many wrong tries, TrilloPOS asks you to wait 15 minutes.

help.title: If something looks wrong
help.report: Write down what you did and what you expected, take a screenshot, and send both to the person who set up TrilloPOS for you.
help.history: Nothing in TrilloPOS is ever deleted. A mistaken sale is corrected with a return, and a mistaken expense can be voided. That is on purpose: the history always explains the numbers.

productDelete.title: Delete {name}?
productDelete.body: It disappears from your products and the sale screen. Past sales, receipts and reports keep it.
productDelete.stock: It still has {quantity} in stock. Deleting it records them as written off, so your stock value stays right.
